summary: The command palette shows minor alignment and RTL layout discrepancies, including unmirrored table columns and offset calendar positioning.

issues.title: Unmirrored column ordering
issues.description: Table columns retain LTR ordering instead of flowing right-to-left.
issues.evidence: The 'Length' column is positioned on the far left while 'Time' remains on the far right.
issues.suggestion: Reverse column sequence to align primary event content starting from the right.

issues.title: Asymmetrical calendar alignment
issues.description: Calendar container is horizontally off-center within the dialog body.
issues.evidence: Spacing between the left edge and calendar box is smaller than the right spacing.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent centering or symmetrical horizontal margins to the calendar wrapper.

issues.title: RTL punctuation misplacement in search
issues.description: Leading ellipsis appears on the left of English placeholder text due to RTL direction.
issues.evidence: Search field displays '...Jump to a date or search events'.
issues.suggestion: Set dir='auto' on the input element to correctly handle LTR placeholder strings.
